name: io.github.rhombussystems/rhombus-node-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Rhombus physical-security platform. Exposes cameras, access control, sensors, alerts, and AI analytics from the Rhombus public API as tools for AI assistants.

environmentVariables.name: RHOMBUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Rhombus API key, created in the Rhombus Console under Settings > API Management (https://console.rhombus.com/settings/api-management)

environmentVariables.name: RHOMBUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Rhombus API key, created in the Rhombus Console under Settings > API Management

tools.name: entity-lookup
tools.description: Look up Rhombus entities (cameras, sensors, doors, locations) by name or attribute

tools.name: get-entity
tools.description: Fetch full details for a specific Rhombus entity by ID

tools.name: get-org-information
tools.description: Retrieve organization-level information for the authenticated Rhombus account

tools.name: time-conversion
tools.description: Convert between timezones and timestamp formats for footage and event queries

tools.name: time
tools.description: Resolve natural-language times to timestamps for the Rhombus API

tools.name: user
tools.description: Look up Rhombus user profile information
